method: offline Unicorn runs over the memory image. Part A supplies only the allocator (object at global 0x1433365b8, vtable slot 1); CRT memset 0x1c6ad80 runs natively. Parts B and C hook nothing. A code hook proves execution stays inside the listed routines.
comparisons: Part A: all 0x208 dispatcher bytes, all allocation bytes, allocator argument order (size 8, align 16, tag 10) and count
Part B: returned qword for every kind word pair
Part C: rax, both 0x30-byte output records (second untouched), geom, both shapes and the mask unchanged, stack balance; float32 lanes bit for bit
limits: Two-NaN lanes are compared under the emulator rule (nan_rule x87); the manual rule differs in the counted cases. Hardware two-NaN behaviour is not observed.
MXCSR is the Unicorn default 0x1f80; the physics thread MXCSR is not established.
One case in 16 uses a random XYZ mask; the rest use the recovered runtime value {-1,-1,-1,0}.
Synthetic fixtures. Null shape pointers are not exercised (native would fault).
Only the (2,2) tester is validated here; other cells are listed from the initializer only.
